evidence.evidence_text: Automated theorem proving (ATP) has become an appealing domain for exploring the reasoning ability of the recent successful generative language models.

In this work, we propose TRIGO, an ATP benchmark that not only requires a model to reduce a trigonometric expression with step-by-step proof but also evaluates a generative LM’s reasoning ability on formulas and capability to manipulate, group, and factor number terms.
